name: NorTrac 3-Pt. Carry-All Fork Attachment - 1,500-Lb. Capacity
description: This NorTrac 3-Pt. Carry-All Fork Attachment can be used to haul hay, feed, fencing material, boxes and much more. The 1,500-lb. capacity attachment features 48in.L forks with a 35in.H frame and 26in.W between the forks. Product Type Carry-all, Category Type 2, Hitch Type 3-pt., Capacity lbs. 1,500. Heavy-duty square and rectangular steel tube construction with reinforced corners for added toughness Beveled fork ends make pallet loading easy Protective hammertone coating 3-pt. hitch type with Category 2 hitch pins Model Number: 11043203. Age Group: Adult.

name: DR Three Point Hitch Quick Hitch, Category 1
description: The DR Quick-Hitch lets you save time hooking and unhooking tractor attachments! Install once and after that virtually any 3-point hitch attachment can come on or off quickly and easily, without tools! Installs in 10-15 minutes. Bottom link bushings included. For use with Category 1 tractors.
